question: Does the fully frozen expanded-supervision AG factor system improve every primary factor metric and all three residual-calibrated uncertainty families on two previously unopened source parents, then produce adapter-ready factor tensors?

frozen_factor_system.depth: Attempt09 residual seed 29 with explicit DepthART metric skip, zero-mean local shape residual, pooled global scale residual and raw learned depth sigma
frozen_factor_system.non_depth: Attempt09 residual seed 17 inherited support, obstacle, boundary, evidence-validity and boundary-sigma components
frozen_factor_system.camera_height: Attempt10 learned global camera-height head at step 1200
frozen_factor_system.selection_inputs: Consumed FIT and internal-validation parents only; no TRAIN_CANARY model metric was read

success_gates.primary: All ten frozen primary factor metrics pass parent-bootstrap lower greater than zero and favorable-parent fraction at least 0.75
success_gates.uncertainty: Depth, support and boundary each have positive parent-macro proper-score gain and nondecreasing observed residual over predicted-sigma quartiles
success_gates.serialization: Exactly six factor tensors are serialized only after all primary and uncertainty gates pass

next_action_on_success: Run FactorTensorAdapter and the deterministic reducer on every serialized factor tensor.
claim_boundary: Train-only factor learnability and a real learned factor-to-adapter seam; not task utility, deployment, product or safety evidence.
